class.name: LuaNode
class.brief_description: A Lua script running while the node is in the tree.
class.description: Runs [member script_path], or its own code ([member source]), in a [ScenarioScriptServer] context of its own, made as the node enters the tree and freed, with everything the script made, as it leaves it. The script's directory is the context's base directory ([code]require[/code]); its fonts and images are read from [member data_dir]. Its script runs only in the game; a [LuaTextureNode] runs its script in the editor too, so what it draws is seen while the scene is made. A changed [member script_path], [member source] or [member data_dir] runs the script again at once. A derived node hands the script what it works on as the arguments of its file ([code]local drawing = ...[/code]); a script of GDScript extending a node adds its own after them ([method _get_script_arguments]).

method.name: _get_script_arguments
method.description: What a GDScript subclass adds to the script's arguments, after the ones of the native node.

members.member: Where the script reads its fonts and images from; empty for the script's own directory.
The script's file: [code]res://[/code], [code]user://[/code] or a path of the file system.

What the variables its script declares ([code]reloaded.export_var()[/code]) are set to, by their names. The inspector shows each as a property [code]script_variables/<name>[/code] of its default's type; a change runs the script again.
The script's own code, kept in the scene, run instead of a file: its [code]require[/code] and its data files are of the scene's directory. Set either it or [member script_path], never both.
